label: Provenance and source graph
failure_mode: Do not present a claim as verified Lexi when its required provenance cannot be resolved; candidate/provisional presentation may remain available when otherwise safe.
invariants: Provenance survives packaging and cannot be stripped merely for UI simplicity.
First-party and deliberately external evidence remain distinguishable.
External lexical rows require an explicitly approved source/version/license/provenance lane before publishable ingestion.
Confidence is not provenance and cannot substitute for review.
